title: The minimum spectral radius of $tP_4$-saturated graphs
summary: A graph $G$ is called {\em$F$-saturated} if $G$ does not contain $F$ as a subgraph but adding any missing edge to $G$ creates a copy of $F$. In this paper, we consider the spectral saturation problem for the linear forest $tP_4$, proving that every $n$-vertex $tP_4$-saturated graph $G$ with $t\geq 2$ and $n\ge 4t$ satisfies $ρ(G)\ge \frac{1+\sqrt{17}}{2}$, and characterizing all $tP_4$-saturated graphs for which equality holds.
